title: Endpoint Sensor v1 Field Dictionary
text: In endpoint_sensor v1 telemetry, the creator_pid field records the immediate spawning parent process ID (ppid) on the local host.
author: Synthetic Telemetry Team

title: Endpoint Sensor v2 Field Dictionary
text: In endpoint_sensor v2 telemetry, the creator_pid field was repurposed to record the remote RPC broker PID and MUST NOT be interpreted as parent process ID (use parent_process_id instead).
author: Synthetic Telemetry Team

title: Host Process to Network Pivot Playbook
text: Investigation playbook: When WINWORD.EXE spawns powershell.exe with a ProcessGuid, query endpoint netflow records sharing the same ProcessGuid and corroborate outbound 5-tuple against Zeek conn.log within calibrated UTC window.
author: SOC Engineering

title: Office Add-in Updater False Positive Reference
text: Known false positive: Enterprise Office Add-in Updater on host maintenance windows may launch powershell.exe; verify signed script path and scheduled deployment window.
author: Detection Tuning

title: Historical Case WKS-99 Certutil Staging
text: Sanitized historical incident on WKS-99: certutil.exe -urlcache staged payload from 192.0.2.55 (unrelated to current case assets).
author: IR Archive
